title: 東京マラソン2026 に関するお知らせ（大会概要・大会要項・コース図）
claims: The 2026 Tokyo Marathon was scheduled for Sunday 1 March 2026.
The 2026 field was 39,000: 38,500 in the marathon and 500 in the 10.7 km race.
The marathon entry fee was JPY 19,800 for domestic entrants and USD 230 for international entrants, including the entry fee, handling fee and tax; the 10.7 km fee was JPY 5,600 or USD 60.
The marathon time limit was 7 hours, starting at 09:10 and finishing at 16:10; the wheelchair marathon was 2 hours 10 minutes, starting at 09:05 and finishing at 11:15.
The 10.7 km race had a 2-hour limit starting at 09:10 and finishing at 11:10; its wheelchair race had a 40-minute limit starting at 09:05 and finishing at 09:45.

The marathon course runs from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building via Suidobashi, Ueno-hirokoji, Kanda, Nihombashi, Asakusa Kaminarimon Gate, Ryogoku, Monzen-nakacho, Ginza, Tamachi and Hibiya to Tokyo Station/Gyoko-dori Avenue.
The course is certified by the JAAF and recognised by World Athletics and AIMS.
The 2026 edition held World Athletics Elite Platinum Label status.
The 10.7 km course runs from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building via Suidobashi and Kanda to Nihombashi, and its records are not certified.
Cut-off points are set for traffic, security and race operations, and runners who fall significantly behind may be stopped outside those points.
Packet pick-up was scheduled for 26-28 February 2026 at Tokyo Big Sight South Exhibition Halls, 3-11-1 Ariake, Koto, Tokyo, with no race-day pick-up.
The entry period ran from June to August 2025, with different windows by category.
